info.title: attest — trust layer for AI agent artifacts
info.description: Check an agent artifact before you accept it or pay for it. Rule-based, no LLM: the same artifact always yields the same verdict. What is checked: JSON Schema conformance (when a schema is supplied), hollow content (empty values, duplicate items, placeholders, truncation), prompt-injection and exfiltration patterns in any field, and — only when both `mandate` and `action` are supplied — whether the mandate permitted the spend (amount, payee, audience, currency, time window, intent). The response verdict record is signed with Ed25519; the request itself is not signature-checked and replay is not detected. Free daily quota per address, then per-call payment over x402 (USDC on Base); the live quota and price are in GET /pricing.

post.description: Returns a deterministic verdict: `accept`, `review` or `reject`, plus a 0-100 trust score, concrete findings and the signed verdict record.

artifact.description: The agent artifact: object, array or JSON string.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema the artifact must satisfy. Without it, conformance is not checked.

source.description: Where the artifact came from; recorded in the attestation.

generation.description: Optional generation context used to bind the artifact to a chain: model, model_version, prompt, parameters, generated_at, generator, generator_version.

mandate.description: Optional signed spend mandate: payee_id, audience, max_amount_minor, currency, valid_from, valid_until, allowed_intents. Checked only together with `action`.

action.description: Optional proposed action checked against the mandate: intent, payee_id, audience, amount_minor, currency, at.

200.description: Verdict for the artifact, with findings and the signed record.

400.description: Malformed request: bad JSON body, missing `artifact`, or an artifact field that is not object/array/JSON string.

401.description: Only when the operator sets ATTEST_REQUIRE_MARKET_SECRET=1: the direct anonymous path is closed and no paid API key was supplied.

402.description: Free daily quota is used up and no payment was supplied. Pay over x402 (USDC on Base) and retry.

get.description: The free daily limit, the per-call price and the subscription price, read from the running service rather than from this document.

x-x402.note: No ETH needed: the facilitator pays the gas
